# What's new in 1.2.1

Released **2026-10-10**. Full project history: [CHANGELOG.md](../../../CHANGELOG.md).

## Highlights

- **Start Riding.** The workout preview button is Start Riding. The Home manual button is Start Manual Ride.
- **Full-screen close.** Closing the window with the red button while it is full screen returns to the previous desktop.

## Installer

- `steadyGrind-1.2.1-macos.dmg` (this folder)
- GitHub Release: https://github.com/attilameget/HomeWlanTrainer/releases/tag/v1.2.1
